name: teamtext
description: A local macOS app for personalized individual and household team texts through Apple Messages.

scripts.check:js: node --check dev.mjs && node --check server/index.js && node --check web/vite.config.js
scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:python && npm test && npm run build
scripts.setup:python: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
